title: SLO & Executive Health
description: Managed by Terraform (stacks/foundation). The promises this organisation made, and whether it is keeping them. One board for the monthly executive review and the error-budget conversation — no engineering detail, because a board that answers both audiences answers neither.

definition.content:
## How to read this board

Every row below is a **promise**, not a metric. An objective at 99.9% over 30 days means we accepted roughly 43 minutes of failure a month and told people so.

- **Green** — inside the error budget. Nothing to discuss.
- **Amber** — budget is being consumed faster than the month can absorb. The owning team is expected to have a plan, not an explanation.
- **Red** — budget exhausted. The tier's error-budget policy applies automatically: a feature freeze for the owning team until the budget recovers above 25%, with a documented exception required to deploy.

An objective showing **no data** is worse than one showing red: it means we cannot tell whether the promise is being kept. Those are listed by name in the monthly report (`tools/reports.py --report exec-service-health`) and escalate to the owning director in the same meeting.
